items.title: Costco Wholesale (COST) Could Be 16% Below Fair Value On DoorDash Delivery Rollout
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (COST) has just taken its DoorDash partnership nationwide, putting same day delivery from every U.S. warehouse a tap away. That shift gives investors a fresh lens on this membership driven retailer. Against this rollout, Costco Wholesale’s 1-day share price return of 0.59% and 7-day gain of 1.23% sit alongside a 30-day share price decline of 6.87%, while the 1-year total shareholder return is down 3.73% but remains strongly positive over three-year and five-year...

items.title: Doordash Just Dropped 16% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell or Load Up?
items.summary: A 16% slide in a month puts DoorDash stock in awkward territory, and the culprit is something far newer and more unsettling than a weak consumer or a rate scare. The case for buying the dip and the case for cutting losses both hinge on a single question about where DoorDash's real value actually lives.
